name: My Girlfriend the Rudie
source:
Thania is tidy, polite, and she enjoys quiet and rest. Her girlfriend is a rudie, obsessed with vídeo games, kind of a lazy slob, and cleanliness is not her strong point.

Despite all that they still love one another. "My girlfriend the rudie" is a vídeo game (if you can cal it that) where the two characters are displayed at their best and at their worse. Because sure, Thania can be bossy, and sure, the rudie girlfriend might be a tad focused on her vídeo games. But they know one another, and, together, they'll face the world, and their flaws.

[From [url=https://mcportugalem.itch.io/my-girlfriend-the-rudie] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
塔妮娅整洁有礼，喜欢安静与休息。她的女友却是个小太妹，沉迷电子游戏，有些懒散邋遢，也不太讲究卫生。

尽管如此，两人仍然深爱彼此。《我的小太妹女友》是一款电子游戏（如果可以这样称呼的话），让这两个角色展现自己最好与最糟的一面。没错，塔妮娅有时很爱发号施令，那个小太妹女友也确实可能过度沉迷游戏。但她们了解彼此，也会携手面对世界与自身的缺点。

（来源：[url=https://mcportugalem.itch.io/my-girlfriend-the-rudie]itch.io[/url]）
